title: Tree Gnome Village
start: Talk to King Bolren at the centre of the Tree Gnome Village maze.

items.t: 6 normal logs (or a hatchet to get some)

rewards.t: Use of the Tree Gnome Village spirit tree for transportation to other spirit trees

steps.t: Head through the Gnome Maze and squeeze through the loose railing.
Talk to King Bolren. [Chat: 2 Can I help at all? › Accept]
p: The possible routes through the maze

steps.t: Talk to Commander Montai north of the maze. He is wearing red and will be wandering near the catapult to the east of where you are exited out of the maze. [Chat: 1 Ok, I'll gather some wood.]

sub.t: Talk to him again to give him six logs.

steps.t: Talk to Commander Montai again. [Chat: 2 I'll try my best]
Talk to the 3 tracker gnomes (map locations below).
West of Commander Montai, fire the ballista and choose coordinate until successful.
The building next to Tracker gnome 1, climb over the crumbled wall which is to the right of the locked door.
p: Retrieving the orb of protection from the battlefield

steps.t: Climb up the ladder and search the chest for an orb of protection.
Climb back down the ladder and head out the door or climb back over the crumbled wall.
Run back towards the north-west entrance of the maze, click Elkoy to Follow him.
Talk to King Bolren. [Chat: 1 I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.]
p: King Bolren returns the orbs to the spirit tree.

steps.t: Head north-west of the battlefield and follow the Ardougne wall all the way west.
p: Fighting the warlord from the safespot

steps.t: Return back to the maze and follow Elkoy.
